prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively pick a single “best” dentist for you, but I can help you find the right one. To give a quick, useful answer I need a bit more info — do you have a Pleasanton neighborhood or ZIP code, dental insurance (and which plan), and any preferences (gender, pediatric vs adult, sedation, weekend hours)?

If you want to search on your own right now, here’s a fast, reliable way to find a top dentist for a checkup and cleaning plus what to look for:

Where to look
- Google Maps (search “dentist Pleasanton, CA” and sort by rating/reviews)
- Yelp (check recent reviews and responsiveness)
- ADA Find-a-Dentist (ada.org/en/find-a-dentist)
- Your insurance provider’s online directory (to confirm in-network)
- Zocdoc or Healthgrades for availability and patient ratings

What to prioritize for a checkup & cleaning
- High patient ratings (4+ stars) and recent positive reviews about cleanings and friendly hygienists
- Hygienist experience and whether the dentist does routine exams and X‑rays
- Up‑to‑date technology: digital X‑rays, intraoral camera, electronic records
- Clean, professional office and clear infection-control policies
- Convenience: office hours, appointment availability, emergency care
- Accepted insurance and transparent fees for hygiene visits

Questions to ask when you call or message
- Do you accept my insurance? What would a routine cleaning and exam cost out of pocket?
- How long is a routine cleaning appointment and do new-patient visits include X‑rays?
- Who does the cleaning—an RDH hygienist or the dentist—and how long have they been with the practice?
- What COVID/infection-control protocols are in place (if important to you)?
- Are same-day or evening appointments available if I need them?

If you tell me your ZIP code and insurance (or whether you prefer an adult vs pediatric dentist, or specific location in Pleasanton), I’ll suggest 3–5 well-rated practices nearby and a recommended next step to book an appointment.
